title: Monotone Selected Fourier Family
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter, and let $J$ be a set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates. Define the selected Fourier family to consist of all subsets of $J$ whose size is at most the degree prescribed by $t$ and $\varepsilon$.
caveat: The learning-consequences degree function is referenced but not defined in the payload.
